title: Tarantula
wikitext:
'''Tarantulas''' are a group of large, hairy [[spider]]s. Although [[Redridge Mountains]] is a peaceful Alliance region, the mountains remain dangerous at times, with tarantulas in the east. When traveling though here, [[Brann Bronzebeard]] himself stumbled upon a nest of tarantulas. He noted that if you followed the current from the [[Stonewatch Falls]], you would eventually run into the canyons where tarantulas can be found, so most people did not go that far.

They can be found in many regions of Azeroth like [[Redridge Mountains]] & the [[Swamp of Sorrows]].
